top_signals.title: Central banks need to speak, even when they are wrong
top_signals.summary: Kevin Warsh has turned back the transparency revolution in central banking, refusing to commit to regular news conferences and has expressed disdain for "forward guidance."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi will meet his South Korean counterpart, Cho Hyun, to discuss North Korea and bilateral and global issues.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Let them build homes near stations, but let them be beautiful too
top_signals.summary: Rules to allow thousands of new homes near stations is cause for celebration, but the government must avoid creating 'anywhere developments'.
